remarks: Discover the pinnacle of modern luxury in the heart of Darien. Exclusively designed for adults aged 62 and over, this custom condominium flawlessly pairs high-end craftsmanship with effortless living. Inside, soaring ceilings and massive windows flood the open-concept living, dining, and entertaining spaces with natural light. The gourmet chef's kitchen features premium appliances and custom cabinetry, while the main-level primary suite serves as a private oasis with its spa-inspired bath.  Flexibility is built right in, with extra rooms perfect for a dedicated home office or fitness space, plus an expansive, unfinished basement with 9-foot ceilings. Outside, a private bluestone patio with an outdoor fireplace offers a serene escape. Complete with an attached garage and located just steps from the vibrant new Corbin District, this property offers a premier New England lifestyle without the upkeep.
